kind: Independent SWZ14 negative-family screen, physical receipt, and Tikhuba-role predicate assessment
status: Bounded independent assessment only. Does not construct source evidence, run diagnostics, or approve any qualification/disposition.

original_contract.question: Qualify the unique current-location source membership, retained territorial exclusions and complete source competitors; then derive and verify a zero-reassignment additive native patch.
original_contract.completion: Every exact interval is either a qualified additive repair to its recorded location or a documented exception; run actual selected-native conservation and source/physical witness checks. Existing river water remains location-owned.

negative_candidate_bounds.working_file_status: untracked at inspection; reviewed as active research input, not immutable public evidence
negative_candidate_bounds.purpose: Conservative candidate-family screen for source/negative closure; not a polygon overlay or qualification.

method.target_geometry: Exact current selected canonical feature geometry read from two pinned part blobs; only its envelope was transformed to native-grid x/y, with x=(lon+180)/360*262166 and y=(0.5-ln((1+sin(lat))/(1-sin(lat)))/(4*pi))*262166, matching src/pixel-grid.js.
method.run_intersection: Union source_feature_indices from each complete source-candidate-block run intersecting the target geometry native-grid envelope. Envelope is conservative; a candidate run indicates native-raster source support somewhere in the bbox, not polygon intersection with target.
limits: Screen uses source-candidate runs and indexes for blocks 36/37; families that geometrically overlap target but produce no native raster candidate-cell center in bbox may be omitted.
This does not prove polygon-level intersection or disjointness, legal territorial status, ancestry, or a complete source_evidence negative-family list.
SWZ ADM1 rows are broad tier context, not direct owner vectors or negative families.
Stock sourceTerritorialExclusions requires full original source bodies for selected negative families.
method.candidate_family_interpretation: Five non-SWZ families have candidate raster feature spans inside at least one full canonical target-geometry native-grid bbox: MOZ ADM1/ADM2 and ZAF ADM1/ADM2/ADM3. These are bounded candidates to acquire and compare under stock sourceEvidence. They are not proven target polygon intersections or legal territorial exclusions. The 4 SWZ ADM1 features are explicit parent-tier context only; SWZ ADM2 is the positive family.
candidate_family_observations: No MOZ ADM1 candidate occurs inside target-specific point candidate rows; MOZ families are flagged by raster candidate spans intersecting the full Mhlume, Lomahasha and Tikhuba geometry envelopes.
ZAF ADM1/ADM2/ADM3 families are flagged by raster candidate spans within the Ngwempisi and Zombodze geometry envelopes.

The family-level screen is conservative within native source-candidate coverage of the computed target bboxes, but the bbox screen can include features outside the exact target polygon and can omit non-rasterized tiny features.

negative_candidate_bounds.interpretation: The five MOZ/ZAF families are a justified finite shortlist for further negative-family checks: their complete original source-candidate runs contain features in one or more target geometry native-grid bounding boxes. The four SWZ ADM1 features are appropriate broad parent-region context for all eight recorded targets, not separate direct owners and not foreign negative families.
limits: The screen tests raster source-candidate runs against bounding boxes, not feature polygons against exact target polygons; it can include false positives outside a target and miss tiny/non-rasterized features or geometries with no candidate center in the box.

The family union lists candidate feature indices only. A stock negative-family operand must bind complete family bodies, and exact polygon-level check is still needed before describing a feature as an actual target intersection or disjoint result.
This is not a complete competitor closure or legal territorial adjudication. The report itself says it cannot prove complete negative family lists.
The source-evidence code may preserve bbox candidates conservatively; inclusion as a negative witness is not evidence that the foreign feature owns any native key.

tikhuba_role_specificity.retained_role_evidence: The official material associates Tikhuba with the Matsanjeni North administrative/electoral unit at least from 2013 through 2023, and specifically categorizes it as a chiefdom in 2013 and 2018; this is earlier than the 2017 represented year of the provider geometry.
tikhuba_role_specificity.access_record: inventory/swz-audit-handoff/extracted/primary/dated-retrieval-manifest.json and parliament-retrieval-manifest.json; recorded HTTP 503 for EBC/gov pages/PDF and Parliament PDF.
tikhuba_role_specificity.role_limit: No retrieved primary text proves the exact spatial extent or one-to-one ancestry of the 2017 geometry, nor that Tikhuba must be renamed or that the original key belongs to another geometry. The EBC map is copyright-marked and was not downloaded, traced or redistributed.
tikhuba_role_specificity.assessment: Tikhuba differs from the other 13 keys because it has a separate documented tier/role ambiguity: official indexed EBC material associates Tikhuba with Matsanjeni North as a chiefdom. It is also one of the six simplified-only geometry points. The evidence does not establish one-to-one spatial ancestry or a different owner. Direct EBC resources timed out/returned 503 in recorded attempts; the copyright-marked EBC map was not acquired. No presently known accessible unperformed primary endpoint is established. The exact role question remains key-specific and should be tested against the upcoming source/lineage result; do not silently rename or substitute it.

finite_remaining_predicates: For each of the 14 exact keys, the actual source/native result must state membership in the nominated complete simplified ADM2 family, whether any additional same-tier feature matches, and retain the separate full-geometry comparison as representation evidence.

The five foreign families are candidate families, not proven intersections; bind whole family inputs and use exact stock polygon-level exclusions/contacts. The current envelope screen cannot by itself establish completeness against small or non-rasterized competitors.
Bind all four ADM1 regions to their actual roles and lineage while retaining empty direct-owner vectors; do not classify them as second owners.
Use the exact physical stage binding and later native selected-reader conservation; the physical result alone is insufficient.
For Tikhuba, carry the EBC role evidence and unresolved extent/ancestry limitation separately from ordinary source-version sensitivity.
